yourKeyStaysOn: Your key stays on this device. Files in the safebox are locked with it, so that only you and your friend can read them. Not even we can. Messages are locked with it too, with their pictures, videos and voice messages, when you and your friend both have a key.
checkWhatIsStill: Check what is still locked here
everythingCanBeOpened: Everything can be opened on this device.
messagesMessagesAndFiles: {{ messages }} messages and {{ files }} files are still locked for this device. Tap Allow on a device that opens them, or ask your friend to help from the Recovery page.
thisDeviceCannotOpen: This device cannot open your old messages yet. Open Seven Friends on your first device (the one with your oldest key) and tap Allow here under Advanced, or ask your friend to help from the Recovery page.
thisDeviceOpensMy: This device opens my old messages
useThisWhenThis: Use this when this device can read your old messages, but no Allow button shows. It then gives your other devices access.
useThisDeviceTo: Use this device to give the others access
waitingForAccessTo: Waiting for access to your old messages and files.
aRemovedKeyIs: A removed key is not used for new files. Files already locked for it can then no longer be opened on that device.
useThisIfYou: Use this if you lost your secret words. This device gets a new key and new secret words, and the key it has now is removed. Files that are already locked for the old key can no longer be opened.
whyIsMyKey: Why can I not open my old messages?
keysPublishedForThis: Keys published for this account: {{ active }} in use, {{ removed }} removed
accountsWithAKey: Accounts with a key in this browser: {{ accountsInBrowser }}
theServerCouldNot: The server could not be asked just now. Reload the page to try again.
typeTheRecoveryWords: Type the 24 secret words you wrote down when you made your key. The key is then put on this device.
keyInThisBrowser: Key in this browser for this account: {{ no }}
thatDidNotWork: That did not work. Try again.
couldNotBeOpened: {{ skipped }} could not be opened on this device. Try again on the device where that key lives.
doneTheOtherDevice: Done. The other device can now open your old messages and files.
theKeyCouldNot: The key could not be removed.
theKeyCouldNot2: The key could not be restored.
doneYourHistoryIs: Done. Your history is open on this device.
someThingsAreLocked: Some of your old messages and files are locked on this device.
lockedCounts: {{ messages }} messages and {{ files }} files are locked on this device. Choose a way below to get them back.
keyWorksNothingLocked: ✓ Your key works. Nothing is locked on this device.
youCanAskAnyTime: You can still ask at any time, for example to make sure that all your devices open everything.
thisDeviceHasNoWorking: This device has no working key.
theKeyOnThisRemoved: The key on this device was removed, from another of your devices or with "Not me".
theKeyOnThisNever: The key on this device was never saved on the server, so it does not count.
thisDeviceHasNoKey: Your account has keys on other devices, but this device has none.
soYourOldMessages: Your old messages and files are locked here until it has one. Restore your key with your 24 words (below), or make a new key and then ask your other devices or a friend to open your history for it.
myOtherDevices: From my other phone or computer
waitingForYourOther: Waiting for one of your other devices to say Allow.
yourOtherDeviceIs: Your other device is opening your history for this one.
addedOfTotal: {{ added }} of {{ total }} done. Keep the app open on both devices.
oneOfYourOther: One of your other devices said it was not you, and removed the key of this device. Use your 24 words, or ask a friend.
askYourOtherDevices: Ask your other devices to open your old messages for this one. A card shows on them (and a message, when they are closed).
noOtherDeviceHas: No other device of yours has a key. Ask a friend below.
aFriendCanOpen: A friend can open what you shared with them: they open the keys on their device and lock them again for you. Ask one friend at a time.
noFriendsInThis: No friends in this circle yet.
openTheAppOn: Open Seven Friends on one of these devices (it must be logged in and show the same account). A banner asks you to Allow. It does not matter which one.
